title: beConscient
description: Screen time across phone and computer, and the pipeline that collects it: events, devices, derivation and the pods it runs on.

panels.title: Screen time
panels.description: Phone and computer since midnight, counted once when both were on at the same time.

targets.rawSql:
WITH 
seg AS (
  SELECT s.device_id, dv.kind AS device, s.kind, s.subject,
         greatest(s.start_ts, (extract(epoch FROM date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') * 1000)::bigint) AS a, least(s.end_ts, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS b,
         CASE
           WHEN s.kind = 'unattributed' THEN 'Unattributed'
           WHEN s.kind = 'computer' THEN
             CASE WHEN w.days IS NOT NULL
                   AND extract(isodow FROM to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::text = ANY (string_to_array(w.days, ','))
                   AND (to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::time >= w.start_time::time
                   AND (to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::time < w.end_time::time
                  THEN 'Work' ELSE 'Personal computer' END
           ELSE coalesce(c.name, 'Uncategorized')
         END AS category
  FROM segments s
  JOIN devices dv ON dv.id = s.device_id
  LEFT JOIN subject_mappings m ON m.subject_key = s.subject
  LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = m.category_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT days, start_time, end_time FROM window_settings
                     WHERE kind = 'work' ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 1) w ON true
  WHERE s.version = (SELECT version FROM derivation_state LIMIT 1)
    AND s.end_ts > (extract(epoch FROM date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') * 1000)::bigint AND s.start_ts < (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint
) SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(upper(r) - lower(r)), 0) FROM unnest(
      (SELECT range_agg(int8range(a, b)) FROM seg WHERE b > a AND true)) r) / 1000.0 AS value

panels.title: Away from screens
panels.description: The headline number: awake time today (from the awake window's start until now) with no screen on.

targets.rawSql:
WITH aw AS (SELECT start_time::time AS s, end_time::time AS e FROM window_settings WHERE kind = 'awake' ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 1),
win AS (
  SELECT (extract(epoch FROM ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::date + aw.s) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') * 1000)::bigint AS lo,
         least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, (extract(epoch FROM ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::date + aw.e) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') * 1000)::bigint) AS hi
  FROM aw
),

seg AS (
  SELECT s.device_id, dv.kind AS device, s.kind, s.subject,
         greatest(s.start_ts, (SELECT lo FROM win)) AS a, least(s.end_ts, (SELECT hi FROM win)) AS b,
         CASE
           WHEN s.kind = 'unattributed' THEN 'Unattributed'
           WHEN s.kind = 'computer' THEN
             CASE WHEN w.days IS NOT NULL
                   AND extract(isodow FROM to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::text = ANY (string_to_array(w.days, ','))
                   AND (to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::time >= w.start_time::time
                   AND (to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::time < w.end_time::time
                  THEN 'Work' ELSE 'Personal computer' END
           ELSE coalesce(c.name, 'Uncategorized')
         END AS category
  FROM segments s
  JOIN devices dv ON dv.id = s.device_id
  LEFT JOIN subject_mappings m ON m.subject_key = s.subject
  LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = m.category_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT days, start_time, end_time FROM window_settings
                     WHERE kind = 'work' ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 1) w ON true
  WHERE s.version = (SELECT version FROM derivation_state LIMIT 1)
    AND s.end_ts > (SELECT lo FROM win) AND s.start_ts < (SELECT hi FROM win)
)
SELECT greatest((SELECT hi - lo FROM win), 0) / 1000.0 - (SELECT coalesce(sum(upper(r) - lower(r)), 0) FROM unnest(
      (SELECT range_agg(int8range(a, b)) FROM seg WHERE b > a AND true)) r) / 1000.0 AS value

panels.title: Notifications

panels.title: Screen time per day, by category
panels.description: Hours per local day, stacked by the category the app shows. Phone and computer add up here, so overlap counts twice.

targets.rawSql:
WITH 
seg AS (
  SELECT s.device_id, dv.kind AS device, s.kind, s.subject,
         greatest(s.start_ts, ($__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000)) AS a, least(s.end_ts, ($__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000)) AS b,
         CASE
           WHEN s.kind = 'unattributed' THEN 'Unattributed'
           WHEN s.kind = 'computer' THEN
             CASE WHEN w.days IS NOT NULL
                   AND extract(isodow FROM to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::text = ANY (string_to_array(w.days, ','))
                   AND (to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::time >= w.start_time::time
                   AND (to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::time < w.end_time::time
                  THEN 'Work' ELSE 'Personal computer' END
           ELSE coalesce(c.name, 'Uncategorized')
         END AS category
  FROM segments s
  JOIN devices dv ON dv.id = s.device_id
  LEFT JOIN subject_mappings m ON m.subject_key = s.subject
  LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = m.category_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT days, start_time, end_time FROM window_settings
                     WHERE kind = 'work' ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 1) w ON true
  WHERE s.version = (SELECT version FROM derivation_state LIMIT 1)
    AND s.end_ts > ($__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000) AND s.start_ts < ($__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000)
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', to_timestamp(a / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon' AS time, category AS metric, sum(b - a) / 3600000.0 AS value
FROM seg WHERE b > a GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Away from screens per day
panels.description: Awake hours per day split into time with any screen on (phone or computer, counted once) and time away. Today counts up to now.

targets.rawSql:
WITH aw AS (SELECT start_time::time AS s, end_time::time AS e FROM window_settings WHERE kind = 'awake' ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 1),
days AS (
  SELECT dd::date AS day,
         (extract(epoch FROM (dd::date + aw.s) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') * 1000)::bigint AS lo,
         least((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint, (extract(epoch FROM (dd::date + aw.e) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') * 1000)::bigint) AS hi
  FROM aw, generate_series((to_timestamp($__unixEpochFrom()) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::date,
                           (to_timestamp($__unixEpochTo()) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::date, interval '1 day') dd
),
seg2 AS (
  SELECT days.day, greatest(s.start_ts, days.lo) AS a, least(s.end_ts, days.hi) AS b
  FROM days JOIN segments s ON s.end_ts > days.lo AND s.start_ts < days.hi
  WHERE s.version = (SELECT version FROM derivation_state LIMIT 1)
),
busy AS (
  SELECT day, (SELECT coalesce(sum(upper(r) - lower(r)), 0) FROM unnest(range_agg(int8range(a, b))) r) AS ms
  FROM seg2 WHERE b > a GROUP BY day
)
SELECT days.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon' AS time,
       greatest(days.hi - days.lo - coalesce(busy.ms, 0), 0) / 3600000.0 AS "Away",
       coalesce(busy.ms, 0) / 3600000.0 AS "On a screen"
FROM days LEFT JOIN busy USING (day) WHERE days.hi > days.lo ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top apps and sites
panels.description: Where the time went in the selected range. Sessions are derived segments, not app launches.

targets.rawSql:
WITH 
seg AS (
  SELECT s.device_id, dv.kind AS device, s.kind, s.subject,
         greatest(s.start_ts, ($__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000)) AS a, least(s.end_ts, ($__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000)) AS b,
         CASE
           WHEN s.kind = 'unattributed' THEN 'Unattributed'
           WHEN s.kind = 'computer' THEN
             CASE WHEN w.days IS NOT NULL
                   AND extract(isodow FROM to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::text = ANY (string_to_array(w.days, ','))
                   AND (to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::time >= w.start_time::time
                   AND (to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::time < w.end_time::time
                  THEN 'Work' ELSE 'Personal computer' END
           ELSE coalesce(c.name, 'Uncategorized')
         END AS category
  FROM segments s
  JOIN devices dv ON dv.id = s.device_id
  LEFT JOIN subject_mappings m ON m.subject_key = s.subject
  LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = m.category_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT days, start_time, end_time FROM window_settings
                     WHERE kind = 'work' ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 1) w ON true
  WHERE s.version = (SELECT version FROM derivation_state LIMIT 1)
    AND s.end_ts > ($__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000) AND s.start_ts < ($__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000)
)
SELECT CASE WHEN kind = 'computer' THEN '(computer session)'
            WHEN kind = 'unattributed' THEN '(unattributed)'
            ELSE regexp_replace(subject, '^(app|site):', '') END AS "App / site",
       category AS "Category", device AS "Device",
       sum(b - a) / 1000.0 AS "Time", count(*) AS "Sessions",
       sum(b - a) / 1000.0 / greatest(count(DISTINCT date_trunc('day', to_timestamp(a / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon'), 1) AS "Per active day"
FROM seg WHERE b > a GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Hour of day
panels.description: Average minutes per hour of the day (local time), by device, over the days with any screen time. Attributed to the hour each segment starts.

targets.rawSql:
WITH 
seg AS (
  SELECT s.device_id, dv.kind AS device, s.kind, s.subject,
         greatest(s.start_ts, ($__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000)) AS a, least(s.end_ts, ($__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000)) AS b,
         CASE
           WHEN s.kind = 'unattributed' THEN 'Unattributed'
           WHEN s.kind = 'computer' THEN
             CASE WHEN w.days IS NOT NULL
                   AND extract(isodow FROM to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::text = ANY (string_to_array(w.days, ','))
                   AND (to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::time >= w.start_time::time
                   AND (to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::time < w.end_time::time
                  THEN 'Work' ELSE 'Personal computer' END
           ELSE coalesce(c.name, 'Uncategorized')
         END AS category
  FROM segments s
  JOIN devices dv ON dv.id = s.device_id
  LEFT JOIN subject_mappings m ON m.subject_key = s.subject
  LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = m.category_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT days, start_time, end_time FROM window_settings
                     WHERE kind = 'work' ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 1) w ON true
  WHERE s.version = (SELECT version FROM derivation_state LIMIT 1)
    AND s.end_ts > ($__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000) AND s.start_ts < ($__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000)
),
hours AS (
  SELECT device, extract(hour FROM to_timestamp(a / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::int AS h, sum(b - a) AS ms
  FROM seg WHERE b > a GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ndays AS (SELECT greatest(count(DISTINCT date_trunc('day', to_timestamp(a / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon'), 1) AS n FROM seg)
SELECT lpad(g::text, 2, '0') || 'h' AS hour,
       coalesce(sum(ms) FILTER (WHERE device = 'android'), 0) / 60000.0 / (SELECT n FROM ndays) AS "Phone",
       coalesce(sum(ms) FILTER (WHERE device = 'desktop'), 0) / 60000.0 / (SELECT n FROM ndays) AS "Computer"
FROM generate_series(0, 23) g LEFT JOIN hours ON hours.h = g GROUP BY g ORDER BY g

panels.title: Unlocks per day
panels.description: Phone unlocks per local day.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', to_timestamp(at / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon' AS time, count(*) AS "Unlocks"
FROM unlocks WHERE version = (SELECT version FROM derivation_state LIMIT 1) AND at >= $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000 AND at < $__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: What pulls you in (first app after unlock)
panels.description: The app opened first after each unlock, in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT regexp_replace(coalesce(first_app, '(none)'), '^app:', '') AS app, count(*) AS unlocks FROM unlocks
WHERE version = (SELECT version FROM derivation_state LIMIT 1) AND at >= $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000 AND at < $__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Notifications per day, top apps
panels.description: Notifications posted per day; the six apps that sent the most, the rest as 'other'.

targets.rawSql:
WITH n AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', to_timestamp(ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon' AS day,
         payload->>'package' AS pkg
  FROM raw_events
  WHERE type = 'android.notification_posted' AND ts >= $__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000 AND ts < $__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000
    AND NOT coalesce((payload->>'is_update')::boolean, false)
    AND NOT coalesce((payload->>'is_group_summary')::boolean, false)
),
top AS (SELECT pkg FROM n GROUP BY pkg ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 6)
SELECT day AS time,
       CASE WHEN pkg IN (SELECT pkg FROM top) THEN regexp_replace(pkg, '^(com|org|net)\.', '') ELSE 'other' END AS metric,
       count(*) AS value
FROM n GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

                   AND extract(isodow FROM to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::text = ANY (string_to_array(w.days, ','))
                   AND (to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::time >= w.start_time::time
                   AND (to_timestamp(s.start_ts / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon')::time < w.end_time::time
                  THEN 'Work' ELSE 'Personal computer' END
           ELSE coalesce(c.name, 'Uncategorized')
         END AS category
  FROM segments s
  JOIN devices dv ON dv.id = s.device_id
  LEFT JOIN subject_mappings m ON m.subject_key = s.subject
  LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = m.category_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT days, start_time, end_time FROM window_settings
                     WHERE kind = 'work' ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 1) w ON true
  WHERE s.version = (SELECT version FROM derivation_state LIMIT 1)
    AND s.end_ts > ($__unixEpochFrom()::bigint * 1000) AND s.start_ts < ($__unixEpochTo()::bigint * 1000)
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', to_timestamp(a / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon' AS time, device AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM seg WHERE b > a GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Validation against Android's own total
panels.description: beConscient's phone total divided by the number you typed from Android's Digital Wellbeing (last 7 entries). 100% is a perfect match.

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (SELECT day, minutes FROM validation_inputs ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 7),
m AS (
  SELECT v.day, v.minutes,
         (SELECT coalesce(sum(least(s.end_ts, hi) - greatest(s.start_ts, lo)), 0) / 60000.0
          FROM segments s JOIN devices dv ON dv.id = s.device_id AND dv.kind = 'android',
               LATERAL (SELECT (extract(epoch FROM v.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') * 1000)::bigint AS lo,
                               (extract(epoch FROM (v.day + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Lisbon') * 1000)::bigint AS hi) w
          WHERE s.version = (SELECT version FROM derivation_state LIMIT 1) AND s.kind <> 'unattributed'
            AND s.end_ts > lo AND s.start_ts < hi) AS ours
  FROM v
)
SELECT to_char(day, 'Dy DD Mon') AS day, ours / nullif(minutes, 0) AS ratio FROM m ORDER BY m.day DESC

panels.title: Events received, by device and type
panels.description: Events stored per hour, by the device that sent them and the event type. Gaps mean the device was off, offline or its agent stopped.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(e.received_at, '1h'), dv.name || ' · ' || e.type AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM raw_events e JOIN devices dv ON dv.id = e.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ingest requests by result
panels.description: POSTs to /ingest from the nginx access log. Anything other than 'accepted' is a rejected or failed batch: 400 bad envelope, 401 unknown device, 409 sequence conflict, 413 too large, 429 rate limited, 502/503 backend down.

targets.expr: sum by (result) (count_over_time({namespace="beconscient", container="nginx"} |~ "POST /ingest/" | regexp `" (?P<status>\d{3}) ` | label_format result=`{{ if eq .status "200" }}accepted{{ else }}{{ .status }}{{ end }}` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Delivery delay
panels.description: p95 per hour of the time between a batch being sent and the server receiving it (includes clock skew). Spikes are retries after the phone or the server was offline.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(b.received_at, '1h'), dv.name AS metric,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY greatest(b.clock_skew_ms, 0)) / 1000.0 AS value
FROM batch_log b JOIN installations i ON i.id = b.installation_id JOIN devices dv ON dv.id = i.device_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(b.received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: Each paired device, from its installation and its latest health event. Queue is events waiting on the device; a sensor not 'ok' means that source stopped reporting.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dv.name AS "Device", dv.kind AS "Kind", i.client_version AS "Version",
       i.last_seen_at AS "Last seen", i.last_seq AS "Last batch",
       (h.payload->>'queue_depth')::int AS "Queue",
       (h.payload->>'oldest_unsent_age_ms')::bigint / 1000.0 AS "Oldest unsent",
       (SELECT string_agg(k || ': ' || (v->>'state'), ', ' ORDER BY k) FROM jsonb_each(h.payload->'sensors') AS x(k, v)) AS "Sensors",
       i.clone_suspected AS "Clone?"
FROM devices dv
JOIN installations i ON i.device_id = dv.id AND i.revoked_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT payload FROM raw_events WHERE device_id = dv.id AND type = 'health' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) h ON true
ORDER BY dv.name

panels.title: Derivation backlog
panels.description: Device-days waiting to be re-derived. Derivation runs every 15 s, so this should sit near 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM dirty_blocks

panels.title: Last derived
panels.description: Time since a block was last derived. Grows while no new events arrive (at night, for example).

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max(derived_at)) AS value FROM blocks

panels.title: Sequence gaps
panels.description: Batches the server never got (missing sequence numbers), in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(gap_before), 0) AS value FROM batch_log WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)

panels.title: Quarantined
panels.description: Events rejected as malformed (unknown type, missing id or time...), in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM quarantine WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)

panels.title: Interval conflicts
panels.description: Interval rewrites that tried to move a start time, in the range. Ignored by the server; non-zero hints at a client bug.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM interval_conflicts WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)

panels.title: Suspect clocks
panels.description: Events dated more than a day in the future (bad device clock), in the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM raw_events WHERE suspect AND $__timeFilter(received_at)

panels.title: Invariant violations
panels.description: Derived device-days that broke a rule (overlaps, negative durations). Should be 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(invariant_violations), 0) AS value FROM blocks WHERE version = (SELECT version FROM derivation_state LIMIT 1)

panels.title: Duplicates dropped
panels.description: Events received twice and dropped, all time. Normal after retries.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(duplicates), 0) AS value FROM device_counters
